solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Missing son kidnapped by a criminal

indicators.note: a kidnap victim is held inside, so the son's letter is carried within the criminal's word

parts.note: bent is slang for crooked or criminal

explanation.surface: A boy has gone missing, snatched by a crook.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone missing is not present, which is the plain adjectival sense of absent.

clue.text: Start with ABC, possibly as a concept

indicators.note: possibly signals that these letters could be arranged another way

parts.note: taken as written as part of the letter pool
taken as written as part of the letter pool

explanation.surface: Advice to learners to begin with the alphabet, or a thought about letters as an idea.
explanation.definitionFit: Something considered in the abstract exists only as an idea, not as a concrete thing.

clue.text: Lacking a work pattern, gets lazy

definitions.meaning: read literally, without a shift, a set period of work

explanation.surface: Someone without a regular work schedule becomes idle.
explanation.walkthrough: The first definition reads the word literally as shift plus -less.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means idle or unambitious, and literally reads as without a working shift.

clue.text: Victoria needs energy to support revolutionary family

indicators.note: revolutionary means turned round, so the word for family is read backwards

parts.note: kin means one's family or relatives
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Someone called Victoria needs vigour to back a family of rebels.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'to support' puts E beneath the reversed KIN. Victoria is the Roman goddess of victory, the counterpart of the Greek goddess.
explanation.definitionFit: Victoria was the Roman personification of victory, equivalent to the Greek winged goddess Nike.

clue.text: Dismiss sweeper out of form

parts.note: a brush is a sweeping tool
off means not performing well, as in an off day

explanation.surface: A footballer playing sweeper gets dropped for poor form.
explanation.walkthrough: A sweeper is a defensive position in football, which is the false picture here.
explanation.definitionFit: To brush off someone is to dismiss or rebuff them curtly.

clue.text: Description of communist leader?

parts.note: a communist is a Red and a leader is a head, so the phrase also describes a person with ginger hair

explanation.surface: A request for a profile of a Marxist chief.
explanation.definitionFit: A person whose hair is red or ginger is called this, and the two halves read as a red chief.

clue.text: Condemning swordplay, losing head after broadcast

parts.note: a broadcast message is one sent out

indicators.note: losing head means the first letter of the word for swordplay is removed

parts.note: fencing is the sport of swordplay

explanation.surface: Someone denounces televised sword fighting, now headless after being shown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' places the shortened swordplay word after SENT.
explanation.definitionFit: A judge sentencing a criminal is formally condemning them to a punishment.

clue.text: A bit of hope — radio work in the theatre

indicators.note: a bit of means only a small run of letters is taken from the words that follow

explanation.surface: Some hope is offered by a radio play staged in a theatre.
explanation.definitionFit: An opera is a dramatic musical work staged in an opera house or theatre.

clue.text: Quick points resulting in tie

parts.note: fast means quick
E and N are compass points, east and north

explanation.surface: Quickly scored points end in a draw.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tie' looks like a drawn match after scoring points, but it is the verb to bind.
explanation.definitionFit: To fasten something is to tie or secure it.

clue.text: Food for a crackpot after exercise?

indicators.note: after means the crackpot phrase follows the letters for exercise

parts.note: PE is physical education, school exercise
a nut is a crackpot or crazy person

explanation.surface: A snack for an eccentric following a workout.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark nods to the crack of a nut, a pun on crackpot.
explanation.definitionFit: The peanut is an edible legume eaten as a snack food.

clue.text: Unhappy destiny of men ultimately employed by new city desk

indicators.note: employed by means taken in and placed within the rearranged letters
new signals that the letters of city desk are made into a fresh arrangement
ultimately means the last letter of the word men

explanation.surface: Men at a city news desk face an unhappy fate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' turns CITY DESK into STICKYED, and 'ultimately' gives N, which goes inside before the final D.
explanation.definitionFit: Coming to a sticky end is an idiom for meeting an unpleasant or disastrous fate.

clue.text: Requirements for born leaders of drama schools

parts.note: née, French for born, introduces a married woman's maiden name

indicators.note: leaders of means the opening letters of the next two words

explanation.surface: Requirements for natural heads of drama academies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'born leaders' reads as a phrase, but 'born' stands alone and 'leaders of' picks first letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Needs as a plural noun are the things one requires, synonymous with requirements.

clue.text: Verity has got no time for this girl!

indicators.note: has got no means the letter for time is taken away from the word

parts.note: verity means truth

explanation.surface: A girl named Verity is too busy for another girl.
explanation.walkthrough: Verity looks like a girl's name, but here it is the noun meaning truth.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruth is a girl's name, which the clue points to with this girl.

clue.text: One event to be rescheduled before charge is confirmed

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: to be rescheduled says the letters of the word event are placed in a new order

parts.note: a rate is a charge or price

explanation.surface: A single event is moved before a fee is settled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be rescheduled' turns EVENT into NVETE.
explanation.definitionFit: Confirmed and inveterate both describe a fixed, long-established habit, as in a confirmed bachelor.

clue.text: Warn of a few hot-rods being driven around with no end of upset

indicators.note: being driven around says the letters are moved about into a new order

parts.note: the letter pool, taken as written

indicators.note: end of means the last letter of the word upset

parts.note: only its final letter is used, and that letter is removed from the pool

explanation.surface: Advance warning of several hot-rods careering about without the end of an accident.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of A FEW HOT RODS, less the T that ends 'upset' ('with no'), rearrange into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To foreshadow something is to give an advance sign or hint of it, a way to warn of it.

clue.text: The smoke for man worshipped in bed?

indicators.note: in means the hero is placed inside the word for bed

parts.note: a cot is a small bed
a hero is a man who is worshipped or idolised

explanation.surface: A cigar for the idolised man lying in bed?
explanation.definitionFit: A cheroot is a cigar with both ends cut square, something to smoke.

clue.text: Sufficient depression covering European Community

indicators.note: covering means the depression word goes around the abbreviation

parts.note: a dent is a small depression in a surface

explanation.surface: An economic slump enough to cover Europe's trading bloc.
explanation.definitionFit: Decent can mean adequate or satisfactory, as in a decent amount, so sufficient.

clue.text: Almost time, and horse has a terrible experience

parts.note: nigh means nearly or almost
a mare is a female horse

explanation.surface: It's nearly time, and the horse is having a dreadful ordeal.
explanation.definitionFit: A nightmare is a frightening dream, and by extension any very unpleasant ordeal.

clue.text: Unable to talk sensibly, missing company constitutional

indicators.note: missing means the abbreviation for company is left out of the longer word

parts.note: incoherent means unable to speak clearly or sensibly

explanation.surface: A rambling speaker without firm backing gives a constitutional address.
explanation.walkthrough: 'constitutional' suggests politics or a walk, but here it means part of one's nature.
explanation.definitionFit: Something inherent is part of a thing's basic constitution, innate rather than added.

clue.text: A second start: bound to be heard out

indicators.note: bound to be heard says the word for start must be said aloud and spelt as it sounds

parts.note: a start is a sudden jump or leap, as when startled

explanation.surface: A second jump is certain to be noticed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bound' looks like a synonym for start, but it belongs to 'bound to be heard', meaning certain to be spoken.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone out cold or simply out is unconscious or sleeping.

clue.text: Drama with writer in children's area

parts.note: a play is a drama
a pen is a writing instrument

explanation.surface: A theatrical piece is staged with its author in a nursery.
explanation.definitionFit: A playpen is a portable enclosure where a small child can play safely.

clue.text: Piece of writing initially grabbing a Parisian

parts.note: one's hand is one's handwriting

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of the word grabbing

parts.note: un is French for a, as a Parisian would say it

explanation.surface: An extract of a text first seized by a French person.
explanation.walkthrough: Piece is slang for a gun, chiefly American.
explanation.definitionFit: Piece is criminal slang for a firearm, especially a pistol.

clue.text: Plough — heaven's first pointer

indicators.note: first means take the opening letter of heaven's

parts.note: an arrow is a sign that points

explanation.surface: The Plough as heaven's chief guide to direction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plough' suggests the constellation in the heavens, but here it is the farm tool.
explanation.definitionFit: A harrow is a farm implement that breaks up ploughed soil, so a kind of plough.

clue.text: A race to finish — be there!

parts.note: TT is the Tourist Trophy motorcycle race on the Isle of Man
end means finish

explanation.surface: An instruction to finish a race and be present.
explanation.definitionFit: To attend is to be present at an event, so be there.

clue.text: What might cheer a child who's down in the mouth?

definitions.text: What might cheer a child who's down in the mouth?

parts.words: What might cheer a child who's down in the mouth?
parts.note: down in the mouth looks like gloomy, but it means a child whose tooth has fallen out

explanation.surface: Asking what would lift a sad child's spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: The imaginary figure leaves a coin under the pillow for a lost milk tooth, comforting the child.

clue.text: Duck vote, banning only waders initially from bend in river

parts.note: a duck is a score of zero in cricket, so O
X is the cross marked on a ballot paper

indicators.note: initially means the first letters of the three words that follow

explanation.surface: A duck votes to keep wading birds away from a river bend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Duck' and 'waders' paint a picture of birds on a river.
explanation.definitionFit: An oxbow is a U-shaped meander in a river, which may become cut off as a lake.

clue.text: It could make you a little misty-eyed

definitions.text: It could make you a little misty-eyed

indicators.note: a little means only a small part of the following word is taken

explanation.surface: Something mildly moving that brings a tear to your eye.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: an eye infection may make the eye watery.
explanation.definitionFit: A stye is an inflamed swelling on the eyelid that can make the eye water.

clue.text: Food giving you a turn after seconds?

indicators.note: after means the turn phrase follows the letter for seconds

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for second, here plural
a go is a turn, as in it's your go

explanation.surface: A dessert that makes you feel ill after second helpings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seconds' suggests second helpings of food, and 'turn' a queasy feeling.
explanation.definitionFit: Sago is a starch from palm pith, used as food in puddings.

clue.text: Put inside by journalist receiving award from Queen

indicators.note: receiving means the editor takes the award inside

parts.note: ED is short for editor, a senior journalist
the MBE is a British honour conferred by the monarch

explanation.surface: A reporter is honoured with a royal decoration.
explanation.walkthrough: MBE is Member of the Order of the British Empire, an honour given by the monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: To embed something is to fix it firmly inside a surrounding mass.

clue.text: A way out after support is diffuse

indicators.note: after means the way out phrase follows the word for support

parts.note: a prop is a support
a gate is a way out of a field or enclosure

explanation.surface: An exit beyond a support that is spread around.
explanation.definitionFit: To propagate an idea is to spread it widely, which is what diffuse means as a verb.

clue.text: Direction given by personal victory separating two daughters

indicators.note: separating means the victory phrase sits between the two daughter letters

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for daughter, so two of them give a pair of Ds
the second D of the pair
own means belonging to oneself, personal
a win is a victory

explanation.surface: Instructions handed out by a personal triumph that drives two girls apart.
explanation.definitionFit: Downwind names a direction, the one in which the wind is blowing.

clue.text: Straight home after host loses way

indicators.note: after means the home word follows the shortened host
loses means the abbreviation for way is dropped from the word

parts.note: ST, short for street, is a way
a nest is a bird's home

explanation.surface: Going straight home once the host loses the way.
explanation.definitionFit: Being straight with someone means being frank and truthful, a synonym of honest.
